_comment: Copy to creds.json (default path ~/Workspace/creds.json, or set CREDS_PATH). Snake_case per-connector keys. Connectors omitted here are skipped by the harness and the E2E specs. See app/helpers/creds.ts.

braintree._comment: Wallet-only (PayPal / Google Pay / Apple Pay). paypal_client_id must be non-empty to fetch the client token; the PayPal button reads its config from the client token. gpay_*/apple_pay_* are optional and only needed for those wallets. Apple Pay also needs a validated merchant domain (manual).

metadata._comment: merchant_account_id is the SETTLEMENT merchant ACCOUNT id (e.g. 'juspay'), NOT your merchant ID. Find it in the Braintree control panel (Settings > Business > Merchant Accounts) or via GraphQL on any transaction. Using the merchant ID here yields 'You are unauthorized to perform this action'. merchant_config_currency must match the payment currency.
